item.title: Kaga Yuzen: A Hands-On Silk Dyeing Craft Experience — Guide
item.description: Kaga Yuzen is one of Japan’s most refined silk dyeing traditions, distinguished from Kyoto’s better-known Yuzen style by its more naturalistic, subtly shaded motifs of flowers, birds and autumn leaves rendered in five traditional colours (indigo, crimson, ochre, dark green and violet). The technique developed in Kanazawa under Maeda clan patronage, and visitors can try hands-on workshops today, working under artisan guidance to dye a small piece of silk or a simple item like a handkerchief, offering a genuine introduction to a craft that traditionally takes years to master.
